text.arabic_uthmani: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَدْخِلْنِى مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍۢ وَأَخْرِجْنِى مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍۢ وَٱجْعَل لِّى مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلْطَٰنًۭا نَّصِيرًۭا

words.gloss_range: opening connector that draws the commanded prayer into the prior discourse

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: speech imperative governing the quoted supplication

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the supplication from starting as an isolated prayer: it carries the night-prayer frame of 17:79 into the command to speak. Because the connector is bound to {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}), the whole following quotation is launched as a continuation and a divine instruction, not merely a private wish.

topics.headline: continuation from 17:79
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prayer grows out of the 17:79 night-prayer directive instead of beginning as a detached topic.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as conjunction, and the boundary rows tie its scope to the preceding 17:79 discourse.

topics.headline: bound speech-command launch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the connector and speech imperative form one launch unit for the entire supplication.
topics.reason: The surface joins the connector to the speech command, and attachment evidence makes the quoted prayer the complement of the following verb.

words.gloss_range: commanded saying that governs the full quoted supplication
words.root_gloss_range: speech, saying, uttering; locally narrowed to an imperative of voiced prayer

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: vocative address to the Lord within the prayer
supportive adjective attached to the requested authority

words.prose: {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}) turns the whole sequence from {{ar:رَبِّ}} ({{tr:rabbi}}) to {{ar:نَّصِيرًۭا}} ({{tr:naṣīran}}) into commanded direct speech. The broad speech root is narrowed here to voiced supplication: saying the prayer is itself the instructed devotional act, and the ayah joins Surah 17's recurring command-to-say pattern (17:24, 17:28, 17:81, 17:84, 17:88, 17:93, 17:110, 17:111). It also reverses the speech direction from God addressing the Prophet in 17:79 to the Prophet being instructed in 17:80 to address God.

topics.headline: whole quoted prayer as complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that all three petitions belong to one governed utterance, not to separate narrative comments.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the speech verb as head of the full quoted span through the ayah close.

topics.headline: speech narrowed to voiced supplication
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prayer is not silent desire but an enacted utterance required by the command.
topics.reason: The wider speech range is constrained by the imperative form and direct quotation frame to overt articulated prayer.

topics.headline: Surah 17 command pattern (17:24, 17:28, 17:81, 17:84, 17:88, 17:93, 17:110, 17:111)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this prayer participates in recurring Surah 17 commanded-speech architecture, including the supplication pattern of 17:24.
topics.reason: The intertext rows name 17:24, 17:28, 17:81, 17:84, 17:88, 17:93, 17:110, and 17:111, and no guardrail contradicts the command-pattern comparison.

topics.headline: speech direction reverses
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a discourse turn: after God addresses the Prophet in 17:79, the Prophet is instructed in 17:80 to address God.
topics.reason: Boundary rows describe the shift from prior divine address to scripted supplication while the local grammar keeps one addressee through the following imperatives.

words.gloss_range: intimate vocative address, my Lord, with compressed first-person possession
words.root_gloss_range: lordship, ownership, management, nurture, staged bringing-to-completion; locally active as direct divine address
words.prose: {{ar:رَبِّ}} ({{tr:rabbi}}) is the internal hinge of the quotation: an intimate vocative before the three requests. Its root field of lordship and cultivation makes the entry and exit sound like transitions under the addressee's managing care, while the 4:75 and 17:24 parallels show the singular prayer joining known supplicatory formulas. Across the 17:79 boundary, the Lord spoken of as agent becomes the Lord directly addressed here.

topics.headline: vocative with compressed possession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prayer opens with personal direct address, not distant naming of God.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence support vocative address; the nominative variant is useful apparatus but does not override the local canonical vocative reading.

topics.headline: lordship as managing nurture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the requested transitions are placed under a Lord who owns, manages, and brings matters to completion.
topics.reason: The V4 root range supports ownership and cultivation, and the local address makes that range relevant without replacing the simple vocative sense.

topics.headline: singular prayer in 4:75 and 17:24 patterns
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 17:80 personalizes collective and familial supplication patterns from 4:75 and 17:24.
topics.reason: The rows supply concrete parallels in 4:75 and 17:24, and the shared supplicatory shape is locally visible.

topics.headline: from promised agent to addressed Lord
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Lord who was spoken of in 17:79 becomes the directly addressed Lord in 17:80.
topics.reason: The boundary row tracks the r-b-b field across the ayah break from third-person divine agency to first-person prayer.

words.gloss_range: cause me to enter, with the speaker as object of the requested divine action
words.root_gloss_range: entering and going inside; defect or intrusion branches are only background pressure guarded by the truthfulness phrase

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: entry phrase whose threshold or manner is qualified by truthfulness

words.prose: {{ar:أَدْخِلْنِى}} ({{tr:adkhilnī}}) begins the petitions by making the speaker the object of a caused entry: he does not ask simply to enter, but to be made to enter. The paired noun and later exit verb make this first movement one pole of a balanced threshold system, while the d-kh-l defect or intrusion background is narrowed by {{ar:مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍۢ}} ({{tr:mudkhala ṣidqin}}) into a request for an inward transition guarded by integrity. The movement also concretizes the promised transition around 17:79 as an inward request.

topics.headline: speaker as object of caused entry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that entry is requested as God's action upon the speaker, not as autonomous movement.
topics.reason: QAC marks Form IV imperative with a first-person object suffix, and attachment evidence identifies the suffix as direct object.

topics.headline: entry guarded from corrupted interiority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the entry is not only motion inward; it asks for an inside that remains genuine rather than defective or alien.
topics.reason: The hidden-defect branch is not the selected local sense of the verb, but the following truthfulness construct makes that root pressure a valid qualifying background.

topics.headline: first pole of the movement pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first verb is designed to be answered by the later exit verb in both form and sound.
topics.reason: The local coordination and repeated Form IV imperative pattern license the entry-exit pairing.

topics.headline: 17:79 transition made inward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the promised transition around 17:79 is now voiced as a concrete request for caused entry.
topics.reason: The boundary row connects the prior raising or commissioning frame to the movement verb without changing the local causative parse.

words.gloss_range: entry-point, entry-act, or entry-manner in accusative relation to the verb
words.root_gloss_range: entering and access, with the mīm noun making a threshold or manner salient

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: truthfulness or structural integrity applied to a threshold phrase
exit threshold or manner noun in the paired petition
accepted variant exposing the simpler entry-point reading

words.prose: {{ar:مُدْخَلَ}} ({{tr:mudkhala}}) turns the requested entry into a named threshold or manner, not just a verb. As a construct head before {{ar:صِدْقٍۢ}} ({{tr:ṣidqin}}), it makes truthfulness define the entry itself, and its mirrored shape with {{ar:مُخْرَجَ}} ({{tr:mukhraja}}) makes the first threshold half of an authenticated entry-exit system. The accepted {{ar:مَدْخَلَ}} ({{tr:madkhala}}) variant exposes the simpler entry-point possibility, while the local canonical form and surrounding Form IV verb keep God-caused entry primary.

topics.headline: entry as threshold or manner
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prayer asks about the quality of the entry-point or entry-manner, not only the fact of entering.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence allows cognate or manner accusative, and QAC identifies the word as a noun of place/time or mīm verbal noun.

topics.headline: truthfulness binds the entry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that truthfulness is not a loose adjective; it governs the identity of the entry phrase through construct grammar.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies word 6 as the genitive complement of this construct head.

topics.headline: variant tests caused versus simple entry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an agency comparison: the canonical form leans toward God-caused entry, while the accepted variant exposes the simpler entry-point possibility.
topics.reason: The variant can illuminate the agency difference, but the local alignment and surrounding Form IV verb keep canonical causative pressure primary.

topics.headline: mirrored threshold pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that entry and exit are built as matching threshold phrases, with only the direction root changing.
topics.reason: The two mīm nouns share pattern, role, and the repeated truthfulness complement, making the bilateral structure explicit.

words.gloss_range: truthfulness, genuineness, structural integrity applied to the entry phrase
words.root_gloss_range: truth, sincerity, correspondence, reliability, soundness; locally applied to transition rather than speech alone
words.prose: The first {{ar:صِدْقٍۢ}} ({{tr:ṣidqin}}) makes the entry truthful in the sense of genuine, sound, and inwardly matched to what it claims. Because it is genitive in the construct and then repeated after the exit noun, the ayah makes integrity a bilateral condition for both thresholds, with a formulaic resonance like the construct in 10:2.

topics.headline: truthfulness as structural soundness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that truthfulness qualifies the reality of the entry, not merely spoken honesty.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment identify the genitive construct relation, and V4 semantics support ṣidq as soundness of act and state.

topics.headline: X-of-truth pattern (10:2)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the entry phrase belongs to a wider Quranic X-of-truth construction, including 10:2.
topics.reason: The intertext rows give 10:2 as a concrete parallel for ṣidq marking stable footing or transition.

topics.headline: first half of repeated truth refrain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this first truthfulness marker anticipates the exact same condition on the exit phrase.
topics.reason: The repeated identical word at word 10 makes ṣidq a structural refrain across the paired petitions.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction joining the exit petition to the entry petition

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: causative exit imperative in the second petition

words.prose: The middle {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) makes the exit request equal to the entry request. It joins two finite imperatives, so the prayer is not one vague transition but two distinct, positively paired movements: truthful entry and truthful exit. Its short liaison into {{ar:أَخْرِجْنِى}} ({{tr:akhrijnī}}) gives the second petition an audible hinge without erasing the syntactic break.

topics.headline: exit coordinated with entry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that exit is requested with the same structural dignity as entry.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the second imperative as conjoined to the first, supporting clause-level coordination.

topics.headline: opposite movements both affirmed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opposed roots are not mutually canceling; both directions are needed parts of the prayer.
topics.reason: The conjunction links two complete imperative clauses and preserves their distinct directional roots.

topics.headline: audible second petition beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the conjunction as an audible hinge in a compound supplication.
topics.reason: The acoustic and tripartite observations fit the visible conjunction without creating a new syntactic parse.

words.gloss_range: cause me to exit, with the speaker again as object of divine action
words.root_gloss_range: going out, emerging, being brought out, extraction; locally a caused exit requested from the same addressee
words.prose: {{ar:أَخْرِجْنِى}} ({{tr:akhrijnī}}) answers the entry verb with the same causative imperative and the same first-person object suffix. The kh-r-j field adds the pressure of being brought out or made manifest, so the second petition asks that emergence be as governed and truthful as entry, with 4:75 giving a collective rescue-prayer parallel. The movement also concretizes the promised transition around 17:79 as an outward request.

topics.headline: speaker as object of caused exit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that exit too depends on divine agency rather than self-directed departure.
topics.reason: QAC marks Form IV imperative with first-person object suffix, and attachment identifies that suffix as object.

topics.headline: from containment to governed emergence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the exit is a controlled bringing-out, not merely leaving a place.
topics.reason: The V4 root field supports emergence and extraction, while the local Form IV imperative keeps the caused-exit sense primary.

topics.headline: second pole of the movement pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the exit verb mirrors the entry verb so closely that the directional root becomes the main difference.
topics.reason: The two verbs share mood, form, suffix, and cadence, and attachment evidence coordinates them.

topics.headline: 17:79 transition made outward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the promised transition around 17:79 is also voiced as a concrete request for being brought out.
topics.reason: The boundary row ties the prior raising frame to the exit verb while leaving the local caused-exit grammar intact.

words.gloss_range: exit-point, outlet, exit-act, or exit-manner in accusative relation to the verb
words.root_gloss_range: going out, outlet, emergence, release, articulation-point; locally a named threshold or manner of caused exit

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: truthfulness or structural integrity applied to a threshold phrase
nearby Arabic display used as local comparison or collocation
accepted variant exposing the simpler exit-point reading

words.prose: {{ar:مُخْرَجَ}} ({{tr:mukhraja}}) names the outlet or exit-manner that the verb asks God to cause. Its construct with {{ar:صِدْقٍۢ}} ({{tr:ṣidqin}}) binds the release point to integrity, and its sound and pattern answer {{ar:مُدْخَلَ}} ({{tr:mudkhala}}) so the exit threshold completes the mirrored pair. The accepted {{ar:مَخْرَجَ}} ({{tr:makhraja}}) variant exposes the simpler exit-point possibility, while the local canonical form and surrounding Form IV verb keep God-caused exit primary.

topics.headline: exit as outlet or manner
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prayer asks for a truthful route or manner of emergence, not just an outcome of leaving.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a noun of place/time or mīm noun, and attachment allows cognate or manner accusative after the exit verb.

topics.headline: variant tests caused versus simple exit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same agency question as the entry noun: canonical caused exit remains primary, while the variant exposes the simpler exit-point field.
topics.reason: The variant illuminates the agency difference but does not overturn the canonical alignment with the Form IV verb.

topics.headline: exit threshold mirrors entry threshold
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the exit noun audibly and structurally answers the entry noun before the prayer shifts to authority.
topics.reason: The word shares the mīm frame, accusative role, and truthfulness complement with word 5 while changing only the directional root.

words.gloss_range: truthfulness, genuineness, structural integrity applied to the exit phrase
words.root_gloss_range: truth, sincerity, correspondence, reliability, soundness; locally reapplied to departure or emergence
words.prose: The second {{ar:صِدْقٍۢ}} ({{tr:ṣidqin}}) proves that integrity governs departure as much as arrival. It repeats the first truthfulness noun in the same construct position, so the prayer refuses an honest beginning with a compromised exit and carries the nasal cadence forward toward the authority-support close.

topics.headline: truthfulness applied to exit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that emergence and departure require the same genuineness as entry.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes this word the genitive complement of the exit noun, and the semantic rows transfer ṣidq's soundness to exit.

topics.headline: second half of exact truth refrain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah repeats the same quality-marker rather than relying on inference from the first phrase.
topics.reason: The surface repeats the same word and syntactic role after the paired exit noun.

topics.headline: cadence carried toward final pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the repeated indefinite ending acoustically links the threshold phrases to the final authority-support phrase.
topics.reason: The sound row is locally visible in the repeated indefinite endings and does not require a different parse.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction that pivots from the movement pair to the authority petition
words.prose: The third {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the supplication continuous while changing its register. After truthful entry and exit, it launches a new imperative frame for granted authority, so the ayah moves from governed transitions to empowered support without breaking the prayer chain.

topics.headline: pivot to authority petition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from mirrored movement clauses to a new grant-and-authority frame.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates the third imperative with the preceding petitions while distinguishing its new object frame.

topics.headline: formal third hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the conjunction as a visible and audible beat that advances the supplication.
topics.reason: The surface form binds the conjunction to the third imperative, and the repeated conjunctions mark the ayah's petition beats.

words.gloss_range: make, appoint, assign, or grant; locally an imperative asking God to assign authority for the speaker
words.root_gloss_range: making, placing, rendering, appointing, assigning; narrowed here to role-giving endowment rather than physical manufacture

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: first-person beneficiary phrase for the grant construction
authority phrase defined by supporting help

words.prose: {{ar:ٱجْعَلْ}} ({{tr:ijʿal}}) shifts the prayer from being moved through thresholds to being granted an assigned endowment. With {{ar:لِّى}} ({{tr:lī}}) and {{ar:سُلْطَٰنًۭا نَّصِيرًۭا}} ({{tr:sulṭānan naṣīran}}), the broad making root is narrowed to appointment or authorization for the speaker, echoing prayer and granting formulas such as 2:126, 4:75, and 17:33.

topics.headline: beneficiary plus granted object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that authority is requested as something assigned for the speaker, not self-claimed.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence give the imperative, beneficiary phrase, and direct object construction.

topics.headline: making narrowed to appointment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb is about conferring a role or mandate, not physically producing an object.
topics.reason: The broad j-ʿ-l range is narrowed by the object {{ar:سُلْطَٰنًۭا}} ({{tr:sulṭānan}}) and the beneficiary phrase to role-assignment.

topics.headline: 2:126, 4:75, and 17:33 grant pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 17:80 uses established prayer language from 2:126 and 4:75 and turns Surah 17 granting language from 17:33 into direct petition.
topics.reason: The rows provide 2:126, 4:75, and 17:33 as concrete references, and the local verb-object frame matches the grant vocabulary.

topics.headline: from movement to endowment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the third imperative breaks the bilateral movement symmetry and escalates to empowerment.
topics.reason: The ayah moves from paired causative movement verbs to a different imperative governing authority and support.

words.gloss_range: for me, to me; beneficiary and assignment marker with first-person suffix

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: plural beneficiary form used as the 4:75 comparison point

words.prose: {{ar:لِّى}} ({{tr:lī}}) places the speaker into the grant before the authority is named. The clitic makes the requested support personally assigned, and its singular form contrasts with the collective {{ar:لَنَا}} ({{tr:lanā}}) in 4:75 while preserving the same need for God-sourced help.

topics.headline: authority assigned for the speaker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the authority is not abstract power in the air but a grant directed to the speaker.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the prepositional suffix as the beneficiary of the grant verb.

topics.headline: beneficiary compressed into clitic
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the beneficiary is morphologically bound into the construction, not added as an independent noun.
topics.reason: The lām and first-person suffix form one clitic word governed by the grant verb.

topics.headline: 4:75 plural formula personalized
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the collective petition of 4:75 is compressed into a singular request in 17:80.
topics.reason: The intertext rows explicitly contrast 4:75 plural {{ar:لَنَا}} ({{tr:lanā}}) with local singular {{ar:لِّى}} ({{tr:lī}}).

topics.headline: recipient named before authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prayer establishes who receives the grant before naming the grant itself.
topics.reason: The local order places the beneficiary phrase before the authority object.

words.gloss_range: from, out of; source preposition introducing divine provenance
words.prose: {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) makes the requested authority provenance-explicit: it must come from the addressed Lord's nearness. The phrase can attach to the granting act or qualify the authority in advance, but either way the source is heard before the object, so the authority is not self-generated. Its partitive potential remains only secondary pressure, suiting the sense of a provision or share from that nearness without displacing source as the local force.

topics.headline: source of grant or source-qualified authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the authority is defined by origin before it is named.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence governs {{ar:لَدُنكَ}} ({{tr:ladunka}}) with {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}), while the rows allow either verb attachment or object qualification without changing divine source.

topics.headline: source primary with partitive pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the authority as provision from divine nearness, with source primary and share-provision only a secondary pressure.
topics.reason: The local prepositional phrase principally marks source; partitive nuance is retained only as compatible pressure, not as the controlling parse.

topics.headline: short source unit before object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how quickly the source phrase reaches the proximity noun and prequalifies the authority before the object appears.
topics.reason: The preposition directly precedes the proximity noun and the phrase stands before the authority object.

topics.headline: 17:79 devotion into source request
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the source phrase carries the 17:79 devotional frame into a request for God-origin authority.
topics.reason: The boundary row connects 17:79 supererogatory devotion with the divine-source phrase of 17:80.

words.gloss_range: from Your immediate presence or nearness, with second-person suffix
words.prose: {{ar:لَدُنكَ}} ({{tr:ladunka}}) intensifies the source phrase: the authority is requested from the addressee's own immediate presence, not from a general idea of possession. The same source formula appears in high-need prayers such as 3:38, 4:75, and 18:10, and 17:80 turns the divine-origin language of 18:2 into a request for authority.

topics.headline: immediate divine provenance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the requested source is the closest divine nearness, not a generic origin.
topics.reason: The lexical evidence distinguishes ladun from more general nearness terms, and {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) makes it the origin point.

topics.headline: prayer source pattern (3:38, 4:75, 18:10)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase joins a recurring formula for gifts that must come from divine nearness in 3:38, 4:75, and 18:10.
topics.reason: The rows give 3:38, 4:75, and 18:10 as concrete formula parallels, and the local phrase matches the source construction.

topics.headline: authority approached through source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prayer makes the listener pass through source-nearness before hearing the authority noun.
topics.reason: The source phrase intervenes between the grant verb and the authority object, compressing the prior 17:79 horizon into immediate address.

topics.headline: 18:2 source formula turned into petition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine-origin language used of revelation in 18:2 becomes a petition for divine-origin authority in 17:80.
topics.reason: The intertext rows provide 18:2 as the concrete echo, and the local source phrase keeps the comparison at provenance level.

words.gloss_range: authority, mandate, proof-backed power; locally the requested object of divine appointment
words.root_gloss_range: authority, proof, overpowering capacity, authorization; locally constrained by divine source and final support adjective

supportive adjective attached to the requested authority

words.prose: {{ar:سُلْطَٰنًۭا}} ({{tr:sulṭānan}}) is the object to be granted: a mandate or authority made for the speaker, left indefinite so its measure and mode remain open to the needed kind. Its range joins proof and power, but {{ar:مِن لَدُنكَ}} ({{tr:min ladunka}}) and {{ar:نَّصِيرًۭا}} ({{tr:naṣīran}}) constrain that power into God-sourced, help-bearing authority; within Surah 17 it also answers authority granted in 17:33 and authority denied to Satan in 17:65.

topics.headline: authority as granted object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that authority is a requested grantable mandate, open in measure and kind, rather than a preexisting status.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the word as direct object of {{ar:ٱجْعَلْ}} ({{tr:ijʿal}}), and its indefinite abstract noun form fits transferable mandate.

topics.headline: proof and power constrained by source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the requested authority is neither mere argument nor raw domination, but proof-backed power made legitimate by divine source.
topics.reason: The s-l-ṭ range includes proof and overpowering force, but the local source phrase prevents reading the force as self-generated domination.

topics.headline: authority cannot close alone
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that authority lands only as support-bearing authority because the final adjective defines it.
topics.reason: Agreement links the adjective to the head noun, and the construction joins grant verb, beneficiary, source, object, and support adjective.

topics.headline: 17:33 and 17:65 authority network
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a local Surah 17 authority network: granted authority in 17:33, denied enemy authority in 17:65, and requested God-sourced authority in 17:80.
topics.reason: The rows provide 17:33 and 17:65 as same-surah references, and the local noun is the matching authority term.

words.gloss_range: supporting, helping, victory-bearing; locally an intensive adjective defining the requested authority
words.root_gloss_range: help, support, victory against opposition, aiding or being aided; locally tied to the authority phrase rather than a separate fourth request

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: authority noun requested as the grant object

words.prose: {{ar:نَّصِيرًۭا}} ({{tr:naṣīran}}) seals the prayer by defining the requested authority as actively supportive. Its agreement with {{ar:سُلْطَٰنًۭا}} ({{tr:sulṭānan}}) keeps support inside the authority phrase rather than adding a fourth request, and its faʿīl pattern gives the close the force of strong aid against opposition. The 4:75 source-and-helper formula is personalized here by the singular beneficiary and expanded by the added authority head noun, while the final word gathers Surah 17's support arc from 17:33 and 17:75 into 17:80.

topics.headline: support qualifies the authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the last word defines the authority already requested, rather than opening a detached fourth petition.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence supports adjectival agreement with the authority noun; the circumstantial reading remains compatible only as function, not as separation.

topics.headline: strong aid attached to authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the authority sought is operational help against opposition, not neutral status.
topics.reason: The n-ṣ-r field supports aid against opposition and the faʿīl form intensifies the support function; active and passive possibilities are retained as pressure, not used to detach the adjective.

topics.headline: 4:75 support formula with singular authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 17:80 shares the 4:75 source-and-helper formula but personalizes the beneficiary and adds authority as the head noun.
topics.reason: The rows give 4:75 as the exact formula echo, and the local grammar shows the singular beneficiary plus added authority object.

topics.headline: prayer closes on support
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final landing is help, so power does not get the last word by itself.
topics.reason: The word is final in the ayah, agrees with the authority noun, and creates a marked authority-support pairing.

topics.headline: Surah 17 support thread (17:33, 17:75, 17:80)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a same-surah support thread moving through 17:33, 17:75, and 17:80 before the prayer closes on help.
topics.reason: The rows supply 17:33, 17:75, and 17:80 as concrete Surah 17 references, and the local final word is an n-ṣ-r support form.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَدْخِلْنِى مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ / أَخْرِجْنِى مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ
baseline_models.mechanism: The matched causatives and cognate nouns make ingress and egress one two-sided process; repeated sidq requires both crossings, not merely the destination, to be sound and fully realized.

activation_trace.role: Ingress into an interior supplies the first threshold crossing and its manner.
Emergence from a place or state supplies the reciprocal threshold crossing.
Complete soundness and stability qualify both sides, making integrity symmetrical.

changed_reading.before: A generic request for a good entrance and exit.
changed_reading.after: A request that the whole passage across both boundaries, including manner and result, possess stable and complete integrity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَٱجْعَل لِّى مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلْطَٰنًا نَّصِيرًا
baseline_models.mechanism: Ja'l as placing into a condition joins sultan's compelling proof to nasr's active aid; the requested gift is evidence with operative backing, not bare force.

activation_trace.role: Making something assume a condition frames the authority as a bestowed functional capacity.
A compelling proof supplies the authority's evidentiary force.
Aid that brings one to visibility or advantage makes that proof actively supportive.

changed_reading.before: A request for power and a helper.
changed_reading.after: A request for a divinely bestowed warrant whose proof itself assists and vindicates the speaker.

baseline_models.mechanism: The command to externalize the prayer and the address to the Lord as owner and gradual former place every requested transition under spoken dependence and formation.

activation_trace.role: Audible production makes dependence an enacted utterance rather than an unspoken wish.
Lordship, ownership, and command identify the one from whom the requested direction comes.
Gradual repair and completion make the transitions formative, not merely relocative.

changed_reading.before: A private wish for favorable circumstances.
changed_reading.after: A mandated utterance of dependence in which the speaker asks to be formed through every transition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The timed prayer sequence and the promised maqam recast ingress and egress as faithful handoffs among recurring stations, with truthful movement tending toward stable standing.

activation_trace.role: Ingress anchors the reading in the focus ayah's first transition.
Egress anchors the reciprocal handoff.
Rising with resolve to an affair turns the ordered prayer into active station-taking.
A station and abiding place supply the stable terminus toward which the handoffs tend.
Dawn breaking from night marks a recurrent temporal threshold.

structural_cues: 17:78 distributes prayer across solar decline, night, and dawn.
17:79 adds night vigil and a praised station.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies timed thresholds and a praised maqam; I infer that the paired ingress and egress ask for faithful passage among them. A concrete or social relocation remains live.

changed_reading.before: Sound passage into and out of an unspecified situation.
changed_reading.after: Truthful handoffs through recurring worship times, culminating in a stable praiseworthy station.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next proclamation supplies directional content for the focus pair: what enters is reality with staying force, while what exits is unreality whose trace is cut off.

activation_trace.role: Ingress provides the receiving threshold for the arriving truth.
Egress provides the expelling threshold for falsehood.
Stable completeness makes the transition's criterion more than verbal honesty.
Reality fixed against falsehood supplies the durable content admitted.
Departure until no trace remains gives egress its eliminative direction.
Loss of truth and stability identifies what cannot retain occupancy.

structural_cues: 17:81 orders arrival before disappearance and repeats that falsehood is intrinsically vanishing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies truth's coming and falsehood's disappearance; I map that sequence onto the focus ayah's paired thresholds. The alternative is that 17:80 concerns personal relocation without specifying their contents.

changed_reading.before: The speaker seeks integrity while moving between situations.
changed_reading.after: The speaker asks to become a truthful threshold through which reality gains occupancy and falsehood loses it.

context_deltas.mechanism: What descends is delivered as cure yet produces opposite effects by reception; this revises sultan nasir into supporting proof whose force heals the receptive and exposes loss in the resistant.

activation_trace.role: Compelling evidence anchors sultan as proof rather than coercive office.
Aid and manifestation make the proof beneficially operative.
Delivery from above supplies a concrete mode by which the supporting proof arrives.
Healing and restoration specify the proof's supportive effect for receptive hearers.
Increase marks that the same disclosure intensifies an existing orientation.
General diminution supplies the resistant reception's contrary result.

structural_cues: 17:82 predicates healing and mercy for believers but only increased loss for wrongdoers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one descended discourse with bifurcating effects; I infer that it instantiates the focus ayah's supporting sultan. The live alternative is an external protector unrelated to the Qur'an.

changed_reading.before: A uniformly effective authority that protects its holder.
changed_reading.after: A delivered evidentiary authority whose aid is medicinal for receptivity but whose disclosure can deepen resistant loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opposed reactions to benefit and harm turn truthful entry and exit into affective discipline: neither receiving ease nor being touched by adversity should break congruence.

activation_trace.role: Stable completeness supplies the invariant required across changing states.
Ingress anchors reception of a new condition.
Egress anchors passage from or through that condition.
Good condition and benefit provide the favorable transition under test.
Turning one's side away supplies the failure mode during ease.
Distance intensifies withdrawal from the giver of the favorable state.
Severed hope supplies the opposite failure mode during adversity.

structural_cues: 17:83 balances two repeated conditional openings: benefit leads to withdrawal, while harm leads to despair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies affective reversals under changed conditions; I treat them as tests of the focus ayah's symmetrical sidq. They may instead be a separate anthropology of ingratitude.

changed_reading.before: Truthfulness concerns the objective quality of entry and exit.
changed_reading.after: Truthfulness also names continuity of orientation when entering ease and exiting or enduring distress.

context_deltas.mechanism: Action issues from a governing pattern and travels a path; the focus prayer can therefore seek truthful transitions at the level where disposition becomes action, not only at external doors.

activation_trace.role: Interior and hidden disposition supply the inward side of the focus threshold.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies action's emergence from inward pattern.
Fulfillment in action makes congruence between pattern and deed the test of truth.
Purposive action identifies what emerges from the inward pattern.
A governing way and orientation supply the action-producing configuration.
Gentle direction toward the true way supplies the desired calibration.
An extended traversable path gives the calibrated pattern a course.

structural_cues: 17:84 links each person's action to a shakila, then compares who is better guided in path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an action-producing pattern and a guided path; I infer an inside-to-outside arrow that the focus ayah asks to keep truthful. The verse can also be read only as external movement.

changed_reading.before: The prayer governs transitions between external situations.
changed_reading.after: The prayer also governs the passage by which inward configuration becomes outward action along a path.

context_deltas.mechanism: Divine provenance, limited human knowledge, possible removal, lack of a substitute guardian, and restoration by mercy recast sultan nasir as a delegated and revocable trust rather than owned mastery.

activation_trace.role: Granted capacity and office anchor the focus authority as delegation.
Aid makes the delegated capacity dependent on continuing support.
Authority and its holder sharpen the provenance of the adjacent divine command.
Disclosure to the knower frames knowledge as received access.
Paucity limits any claim that the granted authority is exhaustive mastery.
Taking away and departure make the revelatory endowment explicitly revocable.
A guardian who suffices in an affair supplies the absent replacement after removal.
Merciful tenderness identifies preservation as gift rather than entitlement.
Bestowed favor names the excess generosity sustaining the trust.

structural_cues: 17:85 places the spirit under divine command and human knowledge under scarcity.
17:86 imagines removal of revelation with no guardian recoverable against God; 17:87 excepts mercy and great favor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies received knowledge, possible removal, no substitute, and merciful preservation; I infer that min ladunka similarly marks sultan as delegated and revocable. The alternative is that only revelation, not authority, is at issue.

changed_reading.before: The speaker asks to possess enough authority to prevail.
changed_reading.after: The speaker asks to be entrusted with a capacity that remains God's gift, bounded in knowledge and sustained only by mercy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The discourse cannot be reproduced even by pooled backing, yet its many reformulations do not force assent; sultan is therefore overwhelming in evidentiary standing without becoming coercive control.

activation_trace.role: Compelling proof anchors authority in evidentiary force.
Aid and manifestation distinguish support from forced compliance.
Combining the dispersed supplies the maximal coalition assembled for imitation.
Likeness supplies the attempted equivalence that the coalition cannot produce.
Taking strength from a backing helper directly contrasts pooled support with the focus's nasir.
Turning material through many forms supplies repeated evidentiary presentation.
Refusal shows that unmatched evidence does not mechanically compel reception.
Concealment of truth names the resistant response that remains possible.

structural_cues: 17:88 denies successful imitation even with universal mutual backing.
17:89 follows abundant variation of examples with majority refusal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-imitability, pooled helpers, varied presentation, and refusal; I infer a distinction between proof that prevails as proof and power that compels assent. The immediate claims still concern the Qur'an and its audience.

changed_reading.before: Supporting authority is power strong enough to defeat opposition.
changed_reading.after: Supporting authority is proof no coalition can equal, while leaving opponents capable of refusal and concealment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The escalating demand for material and vertical spectacle is answered by human messengerhood; this weakens the coercive-sultan baseline and strengthens authority as truthful warrant fitted to embodied mission.

activation_trace.role: Overpowering force is the focus branch tested and weakened by the demand sequence.
Compelling proof remains viable when spectacular domination is refused.
Water springing from the ground begins the demand that authority prove itself through material spectacle.
Gold supplies the demand that authority display itself as material splendor.
Ascent by stages supplies the demanded vertical escape from ordinary human scale.
The visibly embodied human supplies the response's accepted scale.
Messenger and message identify the office that remains after spectacle is disclaimed.

structural_cues: 17:90-93 escalate from spring and garden to falling sky, divine or angelic encounter, gold house, ascent, and a readable book.
17:93 answers with transcendence and human messengerhood; 17:94-95 defend a messenger fitted to terrestrial inhabitants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies demands for spectacular control and a human-messenger response; I infer that the focus prayer seeks warrant for faithful mission rather than possession of those spectacles. A historical protective power remains possible.

changed_reading.before: Sultan nasir may mean visibly overpowering resources that silence opposition.
changed_reading.after: Its coercive-spectacular sense is weakened; the stronger reading is supporting proof adequate to a truthful human mission.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing appeal converts supporting proof into a juridical-relational mechanism: God's sufficient, informed witness stands between parties and provides vindication without worldly domination.

activation_trace.role: Compelling evidence supplies the warrant later concentrated in witness.
Aid and manifestation let witness function as vindicating support.
Carrying an affair through to sufficiency makes no additional guarantor necessary.
Testimony grounded in knowledge supplies the proof's juridical form.
The relation standing between parties gives testimony its adjudicative location.
Knowledge of inward reality guarantees that the witness reaches hidden facts.
Seeing supplies direct perceptual oversight alongside inward knowledge.

structural_cues: 17:96 says God suffices as witness between speaker and audience, then grounds that sufficiency in knowing and seeing servants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sufficient witness and comprehensive awareness; I infer that such witness realizes the focus ayah's proof and aid by vindication. The requested sultan may still include other forms of protection.

changed_reading.before: The speaker needs an additional agent or institution to support the claim.
changed_reading.after: Divine witness itself can be the sufficient supporting proof between contested parties.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant mapping from focus ق و ل to mapped ق ل ل, not an ordinary derivation of qul. The mapping is packet-explicit and nearby qalilan activates the same inventory, so retain it only as a branch-mediated resonance, never as a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قُلْ, heard through the packet's secondary mapped root while the prayer asks for bestowed support

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant image of carrying and rising lets the commanded utterance shoulder a task.
Explicit paucity activates the shared mapped inventory and keeps the burden-bearing speech epistemically modest.
Bestowed capacity supplies what enables modest speech to stand under its commission.

changed_reading.before: Qul simply introduces the prayer as speech.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the commanded speech rises to bear a commission precisely from acknowledged human paucity and delegated capacity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The hydraulic mechanism is cross-domain and does not make the focus words water terms. It remains anchored in lexical inside, outside, concealment, solidity, and the packet's nearby splitting and channels; downstream prose should label it a material analogy for controlled permeability.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The doubled inside/outside pair qualified by صِدْق

activation_trace.role: Interpenetrating parts and what lies between them turn ingress into permeability across a joined boundary.
Extraction from concealment makes egress a controlled release of what was within.
Material solidity supplies the boundary's integrity while passage occurs.
Wide splitting and outflow activate the risk of an uncontrolled breach.
Opening and widening until flow becomes possible supplies a regulated outlet.
Gaps between things locate the channels through which flow traverses a boundary.

changed_reading.before: Entry and exit are movements of a person between places or states.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the prayer asks for a boundary that admits and releases rightly without losing its integrity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The rain branch is form-distant from the ordinary adjectival sense of nasiran, and the activating water scenes are demands voiced by opponents. It remains packet-anchored as an analogy of aid's life-giving mode; it should not be rendered as a prediction of a water miracle.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: نَّصِيرًا as the manner of the requested سُلْطَان

activation_trace.role: Rain as relief and irrigation recasts aid as enabling life and growth rather than overpowering an enemy.
Water springing from a source activates the image of support arriving as provision.
A garden enclosed by trees supplies the living field sustained by that provision.
A river cutting through earth gives the aid a distributive and sustaining course.

changed_reading.before: Nasir is an ally who defeats or restrains opponents.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, supporting authority can work like irrigating relief, making truthful passage viable by sustaining rather than coercing.

strongest_changes: The reciprocal threshold prayer becomes a mechanism for truth to gain occupancy while falsehood loses it.
Sultan nasir shifts from owned coercive power toward delivered, revocable, and actively supporting proof.
The proof is unmatchable yet noncoercive: pooled helpers cannot reproduce it, while hearers remain able to refuse.
Human messengerhood weakens spectacular sovereignty, and sufficient divine witness supplies a juridical form of support.
summary.what_was_special: The doubled ingress and egress morphology, repeated sidq, and the context's progression from timed stations through truth and falsehood, bifurcating revelation, limited and revocable gift, failed spectacle demands, and sufficient witness produced several coexisting mechanisms. Packet-retained split mapping and water branches also preserved contained readings a conservative synthesis would likely drop.
remaining_uncertainties: Ingress and egress may still refer to concrete relocation, ritual temporality, mission phases, affective changes, or inward-to-outward action.
Sultan may foreground proof, delegated capacity, external protection, or several of these without disambiguation.
The split-root, permeability, and irrigating-support outliers are branch-triggered resonances, not ordinary lexical claims.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Truth must govern both boundary crossings, backed by proximal effective proof.** `د خ ل:B001/B003` enters an interior, `خ ر ج:B001/B002` exits, `ص د ق:B001/B002/B004` is truth, straight solidity, and fulfillment, `ل د ن:B002` proximal source-boundary, `س ل ط:B002` proof, and `ن ص ر:B001` aid. Entry and exit are exact parallel constructions. I infer integrity is continuity across changing environments, requiring support sourced beyond local pressure. The prayer asks for truthful transitions, not merely favorable destinations.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 17:81 immediately answers the prayer with truth entering and void exiting. This made the requested truthful transitions here the personal form of a larger truth/falsehood displacement.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Truth gives structural integrity to both directions of passage.** Lexical evidence: `د خ ل B001` (going in) in `أَدْخِلْنِى/مُدْخَلَ`, `خ ر ج B001` (passing out from within) in `أَخْرِجْنِى/مُخْرَجَ`, `ص د ق B002` (solidity and straightness) in doubled `صِدْقٍ`, `س ل ط B003` (authority and rule) in `سُلْطَٰنًا`, and `ن ص ر B001` (aid that makes someone prevail) in `نَّصِيرًا`. Structural cue: 17:76 presents forced exit, 17:78–79 restores temporal station, and 17:81 immediately makes truth arrive as falsehood departs. Assigned role: straight solidity keeps entry and exit from being deformed by pressure, while divinely sourced authority supports the mover through both thresholds. Abductive move: the prayer supplies desired qualities but not their mechanism; I infer that support preserves truthful agency amid coerced relocation. Reading change: the request is for integrity across transitions, not merely favorable destinations.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 17:81 made the directional symmetry explicit: truth enters as falsehood exits, confirming that the doubled `صِدْقٍ` concerns integrity of movement across both sides of a threshold.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P5 (17:78-96): Truthful Passage, Displacement, and Repair
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Sound passage requires true entry, true exit, and sustaining authority, while revelation enters a damaged field as a force that displaces falsehood and restores receptive bodies.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Moral truth becomes the structural fit of a threshold crossing, falsehood loses its trace on contact, and healing reaches a subject poised at an exposed brink.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: True Ingress, True Egress, Supporting Authority
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A person crosses in and out through thresholds whose alignment is secured by truth and whose vulnerable transition receives a nearby supporting power.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: entry (`quranic:root_000464:B001/m01`); exit (`quranic:root_000400:B001/m01`); stable truth (`quranic:root_000852:B002/m01`); truthfulness (`quranic:root_000852:B003/m01`); delegated authority (`quranic:root_000732:B003/m01`); assisting support (`quranic:root_001510:B001/m01`); boundary of nearness (`quranic:root_004482:B002/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Entry and exit are distinct operations and each must be fitted to truth. Supporting authority stands at the exposed transition, not as a substitute for passage but as the force that keeps it from being captured by surrounding pressure.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yükü taşıma veya taşıyabilme ile öznenin yükselip harekete geçmesini aynı kolda açıkça toplar; kuşun uçuşa kalkması, göğün yükselmesi ve yolcuların yüklenip ayrılması ayrı katılımcı gerçekleşmeleridir.

Bir öznenin aşağıdaki konumundan yükselmesi veya kuş gibi harekete ve uçuşa başlamasıdır.
Yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlamasıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, sahiplik, buyruk yetkisi, yönetim ve düzenleme çekirdeğini destekler. Bununla birlikte yalın ve mutlak kullanım Tanrı'ya özgüdür; insanlar ve nesneler için anlam, sahip olunan ya da yönetilen şeyin belirtilmesine bağlıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Tanrı'ya özgü mutlak kullanım ile bir şeyin sahibi ya da yöneticisi olmayı bildiren tamlamalı kullanım ayrı tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçim ile ev, hayvan veya başka bir şey üzerinden kurulan tamlamalar aynı kapsamda değildir; tanım bu kullanım koşulunu korur.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlık ya da şey üzerinde sahiplik, üstün yetke ve düzenleyici yönetim kurma niteliğidir. Mutlak kullanım Tanrı'yı gösterirken başka kullanımlar yönetilen veya sahip olunan şeyi açıkça belirtir.

facets.statement: Sahiplik, buyruk yetkisi ve yönetip düzenleme aynı çekirdekte birleşir.
Mutlak adlandırma Tanrı'ya özgüdür; insan için kullanım belirtilmiş bir şeye bağlıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar sahip, buyruğu geçen yönetici, düzenleyici ve Tanrı anlamlarını ortak bir üstün yetke ilişkisi çevresinde toplar; mutlak kullanımın sınırını ayrıca belirtir.

error_profile.preserves: Sahiplik, üstün yetke ve yönetim çekirdeğini birlikte korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, bir şeyi gözeterek düzeltme, geliştirme ve aşama aşama tamamlanmış duruma getirme sürecini tutarlı biçimde gösterir. Çocuk yetiştirme, mülkü iyileştirme ve yapılan iyiliği tamamlama bu sürecin farklı nesneleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız bakım göstermeyi değil, gözetilen şeyi zaman içinde düzeltip tamamlamayı gerektirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Eylemin yalın gelişim çekirdeği ile çocuk, mülk ve yapılan iyilik gibi nesnelere bağlı kullanımları ayrıştırılarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi sürekli gözetim altında düzeltmek, geliştirmek ve aşama aşama tamamlanmış durumuna ulaştırmaktır.

facets.statement: Süreç, gözetilen şeyi eksik durumdan tamamlanmış duruma doğru geliştirir.
Çocuk yetiştirme, bir mülkü iyileştirme ve yapılan iyiliği tamamlama başlıca uygulamalardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar düzeltme, sürekli bakım, yetiştirme ve tamamlama öğelerini tek bir aşamalı gelişim sürecinde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bakımın gelişme, düzeltme ve tamamlanma sonucuna yöneldiği bütün genel bağlamlarda kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Aşamalı gelişim, bakım, düzeltme ve tamamlanma öğelerini korur.

error_profile.preserves: Sürekli bakım yoluyla gelişip olgunlaştırma sürecini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Mülk, iş veya yapılan iyilik gibi bir nesneyi eksiksiz duruma getirme bağlamında uygundur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, Tanrı bilgisiyle donanmış, dinî hükümleri bilen, bilgeliği olan ve başkalarını temel bilgilerden başlayarak yetiştiren bilgin tipini ortak bir kimlikte birleştirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, çok sayıdaki insanın bir topluluk oluşturması ve ayrı kabilelerin tek bir birlik hâlinde toplanması çekirdeğini destekler. Sayı değeri ve belirli kabile birliği bu çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: İnsan topluluğu anlamı, yalnız herhangi bir çoğulluğu değil büyük sayı veya fiilî birleşme niteliğini taşır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, önceki bir eşten olan çocuk ile o çocuğun bakımını üstlenen yeni eş arasındaki karşılıklı aile bağını destekler. Aynı dişil biçimin bakıcı kadın ve evde süt için beslenen hayvan anlamları da bulunduğundan bağlam ayrımı zorunludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Üvey çocuk, üvey ebeveyn ve bakıcı anlamları karşılıklı bakım ilişkisine bağlıdır; genel yetiştirme anlamıyla karıştırılmamalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız tanıklanan aile ve bakım rolleriyle sınırlıdır; genel bakım veya yetiştirme eylemi bu kişi adlarına taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Önceki bir eşten olan çocuk ile o çocuğun bakımını üstlenen yeni eş arasında kurulan üvey aile ve yetiştirme ilişkisidir. Bazı kullanımlarda bakıcı kadın ya da evde beslenen dişi hayvan da aynı bakım bağıyla adlandırılır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الربيب والربيبة للولد المربوب من زوج سابق، والراب والرابة لمن يقوم على أمره، والحاضنة

branches.source_phrase_ar: الراب: زوج الأم؛ الرابة: امرأة الأب؛ ربيب الرجل: ابن امرأته من غيره؛ الربيبة: الحاضنة (sihah); الربيب: ابن امرأة الرجل من غيره؛ ربيبة الرجل: بنت امرأته من غيره؛ راب ورابة (tahdhib); الراب والرابة بأحد الزوجين إذا تولى تربية الولد؛ الربيب والربيبة بذلك الولد (mufradat); ربيب الرجل ابن امرأته؛ الراب الذي يقوم على أمر الربيب (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, koyulaşmış meyve özü veya yağ tortusu olan bir maddeyi ve bu maddeyle deri kap, yiyecek ya da ilacın işlenip güçlendirilmesini tutarlı biçimde bir araya getirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Maddenin kendisi ile o madde kullanılarak işlenmiş nesne ayrıdır; sahiplik ve yönetim anlamları bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan koyu öz veya tortu ile onun kullanıldığı işleme alanında kalır; benzer sesli sahiplik anlamına genişlemez.

concept_map.definition: Meyveden koyulaştırılmış öz ya da yağın koyu tortusudur; ayrıca deri kap, yiyecek veya ilaç bu madde sürülerek ya da katılarak işlenip güçlendirilir.

facets.statement: Temel madde koyu bir meyve özü veya yağın dibinde kalan koyu tortudur.
Deri, kap, yiyecek ve ilaç bu maddeyle işlenir, sağlamlaştırılır veya hazırlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar koyu öz ve yağ tortusu anlamını, deri kapların güçlendirilmesi ile yiyecek ve ilaçların bu maddeyle hazırlanması kullanımına bağlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Maddenin kendisini ve ondan hareketle yapılan işleme uygulamalarını kapsayan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Koyulaşmış öz ile yağ tortusu seçeneklerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Üzüm veya başka meyvelerden koyulaştırılmış özün söz konusu olduğu yiyecek bağlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Meyveden elde edilen koyu ve yoğun madde niteliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Deri kap, yiyecek veya ilacın koyu öz kullanılarak hazırlandığı bağlamda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Maddeyle işleme ve sağlamlaştırma ilişkisini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: koyu meyve özü veya yağ tortusu

error_profile.preserves: Koyulaştırılmış meyve özü anlamını korur.
error_profile.loses: Yağ tortusu ile deri, kap ve ilaç işleme kapsamını kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Meyve özü veya yağ tortusuyla deri, kap, yiyecek ve ilacı işleyip güçlendirme odak dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Erimiş metal, irin, katran suyu ve ekmek döküntüsü gibi çok çeşitli maddeler komşu dalda bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da yağın koyu tortusu veya yoğun bir çökeltiyi adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal belirli koyu özü ve onun işleme işlevini anlatır; komşu dal ise ortak bir işlem olmadan çok farklı eriyik ve tortu türlerini aynı ad altında toplar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; yağ tortusu ortaklığını gerçek bir sınır farkıyla gösteren aday seçildi, yalnız yiyecek veya kalıntı alanını paylaşanlar elendi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الرُّبّ الطلاء الخاثر أو ثفل السمن والزيت، والسقاء والنحي والأديم والدواء والطعام إذا جعل فيه الرُّبّ أو أصلح به
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الرب بمعنى المالك أو السيد، ولا حرف رب
branches.source_phrase_ar: رب السمن والزيت: ثفله الأسود؛ سقاء مربوب إذا أصلح بالرب (jamhara); الرب: الطلاء الخاثر؛ سقاء مربوب؛ المرببات الأنبجات (sihah); رب فلان نحيه إذا جعل فيه الرب ومتنه به؛ نحي مربوب (tahdhib); رببت الأديم بالسمن، والدواء بالعسل، وسقاء مربوب (mufradat); هذا سقاء مربوب بالرب؛ الرب للعنب وغيره لأنه يرب به الشيء (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, bir yere bağlanıp oradan ayrılmama çekirdeğini insan, deve ve bulut için destekler; süreklilik ve yaklaşma anlamları da kalıcılık eksenine bağlı yan gelişmelerdir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Temel sınır bir yerde kalma ve sürmedir; hareketin kendisi veya bulutun türü bu dalın çekirdeği değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yer, hayvan ve bulutla kurulan bağlı kullanımlar ayrı örnekler olarak korunur; bunlardan biri bütün dalın tek yalın anlamı yapılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir yerde kalıp oradan ayrılmamak veya bir durumun kesilmeden sürmesidir. Hayvanın bir eşe bağlanması ve bir şeye yaklaşma anlamı bu kalıcılık çekirdeğinin özel uzantılarıdır.

facets.statement: Kişi, hayvan veya başka bir varlık bulunduğu yere bağlanır ve oradan ayrılmaz.
Bulutun ya da rüzgârın sürmesi, kalıcılığın zamansal genişlemesidir.
Hayvanın eşe bağlanması ve bir şeye yaklaşma, çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar yerde kalma, hayvanın belli yere veya eşe bağlanması, bulut ile rüzgârın sürmesi ve yaklaşmayı kalıcılık çevresinde toplar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yer bağlılığı ile kesintisiz devamın ortak çekirdeğini anlatan genel bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yerden ayrılmama, bağlı kalma ve süreklilik öğelerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin veya hayvan topluluğunun belirli yerde kalması bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli yere bağlanma ve oradan ayrılmama sınırını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bulutun veya rüzgârın kesilmeden devam ettiği zamansal bağlamda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bir durumun kesintisiz sürmesi anlamını korur.
Hareket etmeme ve bir yerde kalma yönünü korur.
error_profile.adds: Geçici duraklama ve yalnız hareketsizlik gibi kalıcılık gerektirmeyen durumları ekler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bulutun sürmesi, hayvanın bağlanması ve bir şeye yaklaşma uzantıları odak dalda bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da kişinin belirli bir yerde kalıp ayrılmamasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: İnsan için yerleşik kalma alanında güçlü biçimde örtüşürler; odak dal aynı çekirdeği hava olaylarına, hayvan davranışına ve yaklaşmaya genişletir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; yerden ayrılmama çekirdeğini en yakın biçimde paylaşan aday seçildi, yalnız süre, hareketsizlik veya hareket alanını paylaşanlar yayımlanmadı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه رب أو أرب بالمكان إذا أقام، ومرب الإبل ومرابها، وأربت السحابة أو الجنوب إذا دامت، والإرباب بمعنى الدنو
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس السحاب نفسه إذا سمي ربابا، ولا شاة رُبّى خاصة
branches.source_phrase_ar: رب بالمكان وأرب إذا أقام به (jamhara); مرب الإبل حيث لزمته؛ أربت الإبل؛ أربت الناقة؛ أربت الجنوب والسحابة أي دامت؛ الأرباب الدنو (sihah); أرب فلان بالمكان إذا أقام به فلم يبرحه؛ مرب الإبل أي حيث لزمته (tahdhib); أربت السحابة: دامت؛ أرب فلان بمكان كذا (mufradat); الأصل الآخر لزوم الشيء والإقامة عليه؛ أربت السحابة؛ الإرباب الدنو (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, birbirine binmiş ya da aşağıda asılı duran bir bulut kümesini ortak kimlik olarak destekler. Beyazlık bazı tanıklıklarda belirtilse de başka tanıklıklar siyah olabileceğini söylediğinden renk tanımın zorunlu öğesi değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal bulutun yapısını ve konumunu anlatır; renk ile yağmur veya bitki yetiştirme sonucu zorunlu tanım öğesi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan bulut kümesi anlamıyla sınırlıdır; yağmurun kendisi veya yalnız yağış zamanı bu yalın anlama taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Parçaları birbirine binmiş ya da başka bulutların altında asılı duran bulut kümesidir; beyaz veya siyah olabilir.

facets.statement: Bulut parçaları üst üste binmiş veya aşağıda asılı duran belirgin bir küme oluşturur.
Beyazlık bazı tanıklıklarda öne çıkar, ancak renk bütün kullanımlar için sabit değildir.
Bitkiyi besleyen yağmurla ilişkilendirilmesi adlandırmanın açıklaması olarak verilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar üst üste binmiş veya aşağıda asılı duran bulut yapısında birleşir; renk konusunda beyazlık ile renk değişkenliği arasında fark bulunur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bulutun parçalı, üst üste binmiş veya aşağıda asılı yapısını anlatan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Bulut olma, katmanlaşma ve asılı durma özelliklerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bulut parçalarının birbirine binerek bir küme oluşturduğu görünüm için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bulutun katmanlı ve birleşik yapısını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: beyaz olabilen, katmanlı veya aşağıda asılı bulut

error_profile.preserves: Bulut ve yağışla ilişki yönünü korur.
error_profile.adds: Yağmur taşıma zorunluluğu ekler ve katmanlı ya da asılı yapı sınırını belirsizleştirir.
error_profile.collision: Her yağmur bulutunun bu özel yapıda olduğu izlenimini doğurur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bulutun parçalarının üst üste binmesi veya başka bulutların altında asılı durması odak dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Su yüklü olma, siyahlık ve göksel burçla ilişki komşu dalın ek kapsamıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da belirgin ve yoğun bir bulut oluşumunu gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yapısal katmanlaşma ve asılı konumla tanımlanır; komşu dal ise su taşıma, koyu renk ve göksel işaret ilişkisini öne çıkarır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; bulut türleri arasında yapısal sınırı en açık gösteren aday seçildi, doğrudan yağmur veya mevsimsel yağış bildiren adaylar dışarıda bırakıldı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الرباب والربابة للسحاب، والسحاب المتعلق أو المركب بعضه على بعض، وما سمي بذلك لتربية النبات أو دوام المطر
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الربابة وعاء القداح، ولا الربابة العهد
branches.source_phrase_ar: الرباب: سحاب أبيض؛ الواحدة ربابة (sihah); الربابة: السحابة التي قد ركب بعضها بعضا؛ جمعها رباب (tahdhib); الرباب: السحاب، سمي بذلك لأنه يرب النبات (mufradat); سمي السحاب ربابا؛ السحاب المتعلق دون السحاب يكون أبيض ويكون أسود (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, yakın zamanda gerçekleşmişlik, tazelik ve başlangıç evresi çekirdeğini destekler. Yeni doğurmuş ve süt için evde tutulan koyun özel bir uygulama, gençliğin başlangıcı ise insan yaşamına taşınmış bir kullanımdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yeni doğurmuş koyun, tazelik ve gençliğin başlangıcı aynı düzeyde bağımsız çekirdekler değil; ilk durum genel yenilik sınırının özel gerçekleşmesidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yeni doğurmuş koyun ve gençliğin başlangıcı gibi bağlı kullanımlar ayrı tutulur; bunlar her yalın biçime sınırsızca genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin henüz başlangıcında, yeni ve taze olmasıdır. Yeni doğurmuş koyun ile gençliğin ilk dönemi bu yakın zamanlılık niteliğinin özel uygulamalarıdır.

facets.statement: Temel nitelik yakın zamanda başlamış olma, yenilik ve tazeliktir.
Yeni doğurmuş veya süt için evde tutulan koyun, doğum sonrası yenilik durumunu taşır.
Gençliğin ilk evresi, başlangıç ve tazelik çekirdeğinin insan yaşamına genişlemesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar yeni doğurmuş koyunu, bir şeyin ilk ve taze dönemini ve gençliğin başlangıcını yakın zamanda başlamış olma ortaklığında toplar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir varlık veya dönemin henüz yeni başlamış ve taze olduğu genel bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Başlangıç, yenilik ve tazelik öğelerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Doğumun üzerinden az zaman geçmiş veya sütü için evde tutulan koyun ve keçi için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvanın doğum sonrası yakın zamanlı durumunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsan yaşamında gençliğin yeni başladığı dönemi anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Gençlik döneminin başlangıç ve tazelik niteliğini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yeni doğurmuş veya sütü için evde tutulan koyun
bir şeyin yeni ve taze dönemi

error_profile.preserves: İnsan yaşamındaki erken dönem yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Genel yenilik ve tazelik ile yeni doğurmuş hayvan kapsamını kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yeni doğurmuş ve süt için evde tutulan koyun odak dalın özel kullanım alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Genç kişi ve başlangıç durumundaki çok çeşitli nesneler komşu dalda daha geniş biçimde yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir şeyin başlangıçta, yakın zamanlı ve taze olmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Genel yenilik alanında örtüşürler; odak dal doğum sonrası koyun ve gençliğin ilk dönemiyle belirginleşirken komşu dal yaş ve nesne bakımından daha geniştir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel tazelik ile doğum sonrası özel kullanım arasındaki sınırı gösteren aday seçildi, yalnız süt, gebelik veya emzirme alanını paylaşanlar alınmadı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الشاة الرُّبّى والرباب لقرب العهد بالولادة أو لزوم البيت للبن، وربان الشيء بمعنى حدثانه وطراءته، وربى الشباب
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس مطلق لزوم المكان، ولا الربيبة للولد المربوب
branches.source_phrase_ar: الربى: الشاة التي وضعت حديثا؛ قرب العهد بالولادة؛ بربانه أي بحدثانه وجدته وطراءته (sihah); الربى: أول الشباب؛ الربان من كل شيء: حدثانه؛ الشاة فهي ربى (tahdhib); الشاة الربي التي تحتبس في البيت للبن؛ التي وضعت حديثا (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, kura veya kumar oklarını bir arada tutan deri parçası, bez ya da okluk benzeri kabı tutarlı biçimde gösterir. Okların topluca kendisi de kabın bir araya getirme işlevinden doğan yakın kullanımdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal tek bir ok veya kura çubuğunu değil, bunları bir arada tutan kap ya da topluluğu anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız ok ve kura çubuklarını toplayan kap ile toplu oklar anlamında kalır; tek tek ok adlarına genişlemez.

concept_map.definition: Kura veya kumarda kullanılan ok ve çubukları bir arada tutan deri ya da bez kap; buna bağlı olarak kabın içindeki okların topluluğudur.

facets.statement: Deri veya bezden yapılan kap, kura oklarını ve çubuklarını bir arada tutar.
Kabın içindeki okların topluluğu, kapsayan nesneden kapsanana geçen kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar deri parçası, bez veya okluğa benzer kap anlatımında birleşir ve kura oklarının topluluğunu bununla bağlantılı olarak verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kura veya kumar oklarının konduğu deri ya da bez kabı anlatan temel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kap olma, okları toplama ve kura bağlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kabın kendisinden çok içinde bir araya getirilmiş okların bütünü kastedildiğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Okların tek tek değil toplu hâlde bulunması yönünü korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: kura oklarını bir arada tutan deri veya bez kap

error_profile.preserves: Okları içinde toplama ve taşıma işlevini korur.
error_profile.adds: Savaş ve av oklarına özgü genel taşıma kabı anlamını ekler.
error_profile.collision: Kura ve kumar bağlamındaki özel kap ile sıradan ok kabını karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kura çubuklarını bir arada tutan kap ve onların toplu hâli odak dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Uç ve tüy takılmamış tek ok gövdesi ya da tek kura çubuğu komşu dalın çekirdeğidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da kura veya kumarda kullanılan ok biçimli çubuklarla ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal çubukları toplayan kap veya takım düzeyindedir; komşu dal ise tek bir çubuğun kendisini adlandırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; kap ile içindeki tek çubuk arasındaki temel ayrımı gösteren aday seçildi, belirli sıra okları ve oyunun bütünü tekrara yol açmamak için alınmadı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الربابة للجلدة أو الوعاء الذي تجمع فيه القداح أو سهام الميسر، وجماعة السهام نفسها
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليست الربابة العهد، ولا الرباب السحاب
branches.source_phrase_ar: الربابة: قطعة من أدم تجمع فيها القداح (jamhara); الربابة شبيهة بالكنانة تجمع فيها سهام الميسر؛ جماعة السهام (sihah); الربابة: جماعة السهام؛ الجلدة التي تجمع فيها السهام (tahdhib); لما يجمع فيه القدح ربابة (mufradat); الخرقة التي يجعل فيها القداح ربابة (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, tarafları birbirine bağlayan sözleşme, güvence ve bağlılık düzenini ortak çekirdek olarak destekler. Vergi veya onda bir pay anlamı, alındığında bağlayıcı söz gibi işlemesiyle açıklanan ikincil bir uzantıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Ana anlam karşılıklı bağlılık doğuran söz ve güvencedir; vergi payı ancak bu bağlayıcılığa dayanan özel kullanımdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan sözleşme, güvence ve ona bağlı insanlar alanında kalır; aynı biçimdeki kap veya bulut anlamları dışarıda tutulur.

concept_map.definition: İnsanları karşılıklı bağlılık, güvence veya dayanışma içinde birleştiren sözleşme ve verilmiş sözdür. Bu sözleşmeye bağlı kişiler ile söz gibi bağlayıcı sayılan vergi payı da ilişkili kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Karşılıklı söz ve güvence, taraflar arasında bağlayıcı bir ilişki kurar.
Sözleşmeye bağlı kişiler bu bağın tarafları olarak topluca adlandırılır.
Vergi veya onda bir pay, bağlayıcı söz gibi işlediği açıklamasıyla aynı alana genişler.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, bir şeyin önceki durumuna göre nicelikçe artmasını veya düzeyce yükselmesini ortak çekirdek olarak verir. Yaranın, toprağın ve malın artması ile birinin üzerinde bulunma örnekleri bu çekirdeğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal genel artma ve yükselmeyi kapsar; belirli bir yer biçimini, alışveriş hükmünü veya solunum rahatsızlığını kendi başına tanımlamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel artma ve yükselme çekirdeği ile belirli yapılardaki köpük, şiddet ve birinin üstünde bulunma kullanımları ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin miktar, hacim, düzey veya konum bakımından önceki durumunun üstüne çıkmasıdır. Bu yükseliş büyüme, kabarma, şiddetlenme ya da başka bir şeyin üzerinde bulunma biçiminde gerçekleşebilir.

facets.statement: Bir şey nicelikçe artar veya düzeyce yükselir.
Toprak ve benzeri şeylerde artış, şişme veya kabarma olarak görünür.
Belirli yapılarda köpüğün yukarı çıkmasını veya bir etkinin olağandan güçlü olmasını anlatır.
Birinin ya da bir şeyin ötekinden daha yukarıda bulunmasına uzanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtların ortak noktası, artma ile yükselmeyi tek bir yukarı yönlü değişim çekirdeğinde birleştirmeleridir; değişen yalnızca artan şey ve artışın görünüşüdür.

concept_gloss.applicability: Miktar, hacim, düzey ya da konumun önceki durumun üstüne çıktığı genel kullanımlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hem niceliksel artışı hem de düzey veya konum bakımından yükselmeyi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Toprağın suyla şişmesi veya hacmi görülebilir biçimde artan bir şey için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hacimce artma ve yukarı doğru kabarma görünümünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Başka artış türlerini ve yalnızca konumsal yükselmeyi kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin başka bir şeyden daha yüksek bir konuma eriştiği karşılaştırmalı kullanıma uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Karşılaştırmalı yükseklik ve üstte bulunma ilişkisini korur.
error_profile.loses: Niceliksel artışı ve kabarma biçimindeki değişimi dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, farklı söz biçimlerini çevresindeki araziden yükselen yer anlamında birleştirir. Dalın kimliği genel yükselme eylemi değil, yükselmiş arazi parçasıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal arazi üzerindeki yükseltiyle sınırlıdır; her türlü artışa, mali fazlalığa veya soluk sıkışmasına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan yükselmiş arazi anlamını verir; başka dallardaki işlem veya yapı bağımlı anlamlar buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Çevresindeki yer yüzeyinden daha yukarıda bulunan arazi parçasıdır. Biçiminin yuvarlak, sarp ya da geniş olması anlamın zorunlu bir parçası değildir.

facets.statement: Arazi parçası çevresindeki yerden daha yüksekte bulunur.
Aynı yükselmiş arazi anlamı birden çok söz biçimiyle adlandırılır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Çevresindeki yer yüzeyinden daha yüksek olan arazi parçasını genel olarak adlandırır.
